confirm_clear_body: Remove the {count} file(s) from the list? The files themselves stay where they are.
confirm_hint: This confirmation can be turned off in Preferences, under Renaming.
confirm_rename_body: Rename {count} file(s) on disk with the proposed names?
details_fetch_first: Fetch data first to see the matching titles.
details_invalid_number: Season and episode must be whole numbers.
details_missing: This file is no longer in the list.
details_override_hint: What you type here wins over what the lookup found, for this file only.
details_select: Select a title to see its details.
feedback_export_failed: The summary could not be exported: {error}
feedback_nothing_to_export: There is no summary to export yet.
feedback_nothing_to_rename: There is nothing to rename yet.
files_empty: Add files or a folder, or drop them on the window.
files_rescan: Drop the files that no longer exist
lookup_error_no_title: No title to search for: type one in the Name field.
lookup_notice_ambiguous: Some files could be a movie or an episode: pick a type.
lookup_notice_unknown: The type of some files is unknown: pick a type.
metadata_error_rate_limited: Too many requests, try again later: {detail}
naming_tokens: Default: {template}. Tokens: {n} title, {y} year, {s} season, {e} episode, {t} episode title.
nav_hint: {modifier}+O adds files, Delete removes the selected one. Files can be dropped anywhere.
preferences_about_description: Renames movie and TV episode files from their names and online metadata.
preferences_about_license: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
preferences_about_omdb: OMDb: data from the OMDb API (omdbapi.com).
preferences_about_tmdb: TMDB: this product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
preferences_about_tvmaze: TVmaze: data provided by TVmaze (tvmaze.com) under CC BY-SA.
preferences_confirm_clear_desc: Asks before every file is removed from the list.
preferences_confirm_rename_desc: Asks before files are renamed on disk. A dry run never asks.
preferences_confirmations_desc: When KayaBot asks before doing something hard to undo.
preferences_connections_desc: The metadata sources KayaBot looks files up in.
preferences_dry_run_desc: Applies the next time KayaBot starts: every session then begins with dry run on.
preferences_interface_language_desc: The language of KayaBot's menus and messages.
preferences_key_missing: Missing: lookups on this source will fail.
preferences_keys_desc: Saved as you type, in a file only your user account can read.
preferences_keys_env: An environment variable (KAYABOT_TMDB_API_KEY, KAYABOT_TVDB_API_KEY, KAYABOT_OMDB_API_KEY, KAYABOT_TVMAZE_USER_AGENT) wins over its field.
preferences_keys_file_missing: Nothing saved yet. Keys will go to {path}.
preferences_keys_file_unreadable: {path} could not be read. Typing a key rewrites it.
preferences_keys_save_failed: The keys could not be saved: {error}
preferences_language_desc: The language of the interface, and of the titles fetched from the sources.
preferences_metadata_language_desc: The language titles and episode names are fetched in.
preferences_metadata_region_desc: The country titles and release dates are localized for.
preferences_movie_template_desc: Left empty, the default shown in the field applies.
preferences_naming_desc: How new names are built: {n} is the title, {y} the year, {s} the season, {e} the episode, {t} the episode title.
preferences_no_config_dir: This system has no configuration folder for KayaBot.
preferences_open_folder_failed: The folder could not be opened: {error}
preferences_renaming_desc: Confirmations, and the shape of new names.
preferences_series_template_desc: Left empty, the default shown in the field applies.
preferences_storage_desc: Where your keys and preferences are kept on this computer.
preferences_tvmaze_agent_desc: Optional: how KayaBot introduces itself to TVmaze.
summary_dry_run_adjusted: Would become {path} (the name was taken, so it is numbered)
summary_renamed_adjusted: Renamed to {path} (the name was taken, so it is numbered)
